body:
Lately, I have been very critical of organized Jewry.  Some liberals in this
forum may feel repulsed at what I have said, and may perceive me to be a
devil incarnate.  Even conservatives may not like what I have said, after
all, conservatives feel guilt too -- however irrational it may be -- as well
as a need to conform.  I've decided I no longer want to use euphemisms in
expressing my thoughts.  I want to express what is on my mind.  If you don't
like it, tough.  Go to Germany, France or Britain where it is a crime for
people to say what I have.

People believe the Jews are victims, and there is no doubt they have been
victimized through history.  However, as I have pointed out, Jews have often
brought the hate onto themselves.  In the ancient times, as well as in the
Middle Ages, Jews drove many Christian peasants into bankruptcy with their
usury and money-lending, often charging exorbitant rates of interest.  This
is, for the most part, what drove anti-Semitism, contrary to what the media
says.

I also believe the extreme sympathy for the Jews in this country, as well as
in western Europe, is driven by both ethnocentrism and the efficacy of the
Jewish propaganda machine.  For example, Jews are only 2.5% of the
population yet are 60% of Hollywood -- how can that not affect the
information we receive, and thus come to accept as truth?  The information
is bound to be lop-sided; and hence our views.  It is this power the Jew
yields that concerns me.  The reality is, the Jew is not a victim, but a
vicious bully -- after all, he has clearly abused his power.

The notion that this overt sympathy with the Jews is a sign of ethnocentrism
may cause some liberals in this forum to snicker, but it is true.  We, as
spoiled white and Jewish people on the internet who live nice and smug, have
been raised in the same culture, with the same "information."  Just go to
Iraq, Iran or Lebanon, and tell them how nice and friendly the Jews are,
tell them how they should not hate people of other religions.  Of course,
you are too stupid to see past what you have been "taught" to recognize it
isn't about religion, but what has been done to the Palestinians, the
younger brother of the other Arab Muslims.  The big brother will naturally
come to the defense of his little brother.  Yeah, that's the ticket white
goody-two-shoes.  Tell them how they should not "hate."  Watch your naive,
dumb white ass get kicked, because again, you are so narrow and
ethnocentric, yet you think you are so "open."

I have also find it a paradox that the Jews and African-Americans are seen
as the primary victims of society, deserving of restitution (though not
necessarily in monetary form).  After all, as the quotes from the Jewish
historians that I posted earlier demonstrated, the Jews played a significant
role in the Black slave trade.  The Jews have always found themselves where
money was to be made, and were all too eager to suck the blood out of the
Negros.  Are the Jews really the black man's friend?  Sheeaah.  The
DISPROPORTIONATE Jewish involvement in the Black slave trade in and of
itself logically negates any claim that they deserve victim status.

As Ted Kaczynski used to say, you can't eat your cake and have it too!

[Correction: The Anti-Defamation league is a division of B'nai B'rith, not
vice versa.]
